documented_probe: C-a4cb7c45 (emit plan records in the required schema): the covering task is authored at hard, matching the reference floor; the verifier strictly deserializes every emitted record (exact ordered key lists id/batch/shape and capacity/days/code/vessel, float-vs-int type checks, compact re-serialization) on the visible and all hidden inputs.
notes: Hard: a strict-schema record emitter. The downstream deserializer breaks on any wrong key, wrong key order, wrong JSON type (capacity must be a float, days an int), or non-compact structure, so the agent must implement the exact contract. Nonzero rubric: reasoning_depth (three-rule shape derivation plus a five-key aggregation summary), adversarial_inputs (boolean-as-number, float transit_days, uppercase priority, unparseable/truncated JSON, non-object JSON, duplicate keys, blank lines), hidden_case_generalization (three hidden files incl. empty and all-invalid), quantitative_correctness (exact counts, rounding, batch tallies), debugging_ambiguity (a long contract with several interlocking invalid-line rules), dependent_stages (program must be written, then run, to produce the two visible deliverables). No tool breadth, no resource pressure, no unsafe actions; totals bucket to hard.
